name: mini-vllm-inference-engine
title: Build a Mini vLLM Inference Engine

parts.title: KV-Cache Decode
parts.description: Autoregressive decoding over a growing KV cache with a tiny single-head attention LM — the workload the engine serves.

parts.title: PagedAttention: Paging
parts.description: A block manager that hands out fixed-size KV blocks from a free pool, with per-sequence block tables and the logical->physical slot map (vLLM's core idea).

parts.title: PagedAttention: Paged Compute
parts.description: Write and gather KV through the block table, attend over the paged cache, and decode a full sequence — output identical to the contiguous cache.

parts.title: Continuous Batching
parts.description: Admit requests when blocks are free, prefill them, and advance many sequences of different lengths together one token per step.

parts.title: Prefix Cache & Sampling
parts.description: A radix (token-trie) prefix cache for KV reuse across requests (SGLang's RadixAttention), plus greedy / temperature / top-k / top-p sampling.

steps.name: token_qkv
steps.doc: Embed a token and project it to its query, key, and value vectors.

steps.name: kv_attention
steps.doc: Compute scaled-dot-product attention of one query over cached keys/values.

steps.name: decode_step
steps.doc: Process one token: append its k/v, attend over the cache, return logits and the new k,v.

steps.name: greedy_generate
steps.doc: Greedily decode max_new tokens with a contiguous KV cache (the canonical ground truth).

steps.name: new_block_manager
steps.doc: Create a paging manager with a FIFO free-list of physical block ids.

steps.name: allocate
steps.doc: Pop ceil(n_tokens/block_size) blocks from the front of the free-list, or None if OOM.

steps.name: free
steps.doc: Return every block id in the table to the back of the free-list in order.

steps.name: slot_for_token
steps.doc: Map a logical token index to its (physical block id, in-block offset).

steps.name: write_kv
steps.signature: write_kv(k_pool, v_pool, block_table, token_index, block_size, k, v)
steps.doc: Write key/value vectors into the paged pool at the logical token's physical slot.

steps.name: gather_kv
steps.doc: Read the first num_tokens KV slots from the pools into logically-contiguous K,V arrays.

steps.name: paged_attention
steps.signature: paged_attention(q, k_pool, v_pool, block_table, num_tokens, block_size, scale)
steps.doc: Compute attention of q over the paged KV pool, equivalent to contiguous kv_attention.

steps.name: paged_generate
steps.signature: paged_generate(model, prompt_ids, max_new, scale, num_blocks, block_size)
steps.doc: Greedy decode storing KV in a paged pool; output matches greedy_generate exactly.

steps.name: can_admit
steps.doc: Return True if the manager has enough free blocks to hold n_tokens.

steps.name: prefill_request
steps.signature: prefill_request(model, req_id, prompt_ids, block_table, k_pool, v_pool, block_size, scale, max_new)
steps.doc: Process all prompt tokens into the paged pool and return the running-request dict.

steps.name: batch_decode_step
steps.signature: batch_decode_step(model, running, k_pool, v_pool, block_size, scale)
steps.doc: Advance every running request by one greedy token; return those that just finished.

steps.name: run_batched
steps.signature: run_batched(model, requests, num_blocks, block_size, scale, max_new)
steps.doc: Continuously batch (admit/prefill/decode) all requests; return {req_id: generated ids}.

steps.name: radix_insert
steps.doc: Insert a token sequence as a path of child nodes under the radix root.

steps.name: radix_longest_prefix
steps.doc: Return the length of the longest leading run of tokens already cached as a path.

steps.name: greedy_sample
steps.doc: Return the index of the maximum logit.

steps.name: sample_token
steps.doc: Sample a token id from logits with temperature, top-k, and nucleus (top-p) filtering.
